boost_double_trigger.description: Every boost building triggers {extra_triggers} extra time(s) each payday - the ones you already have and the ones you build later.
boost_double_trigger.name: Double Boost

condition_dmg_bonus.description: Enemies standing on mountain, pond or forest tiles take {dmg_bonus_pct}% more damage. Picking it again hurts them more.
condition_dmg_bonus.name: Rough Ground

mortar_slow.description: Every mortar you have right now slows what its splash hits by {slow_pct}% for {duration_seconds} seconds. Mortars built after this choice are not affected.
mortar_slow.name: Concussive Shells

move_time_cap.description: Moving a building never takes longer than {move_time_cap} round(s), no matter how far it travels.
move_time_cap.name: Quick Relocation

musician_auto_level.description: Newly placed musicians - Flute Player, Harp Player, Trio - start {bonus_levels} level(s) higher. Picking it again adds another.
musician_auto_level.name: Trained Musicians

restock_lives.description: Refills the hole back to its full starting number of lives, right now.
restock_lives.name: Restock Lives

stone_thrower_sync.description: Levels every stone thrower you have placed up to match your best one, right now.
stone_thrower_sync.name: Shared Drills

stormpriest_slow.description: Storm Priest lightning slows every enemy it damages by {slow_pct}% for {duration_seconds} seconds, including priests you build later.
stormpriest_slow.name: Chilling Storm

thorns.description: Enemies take {reflect_pct}% of the damage they deal straight back, whether they hit a building or a wall. Picking it again reflects more.
thorns.name: Thorns

tile_discount.description: Unlocking new tiles costs {discount_pct}% less love. Picking it again discounts them further.
tile_discount.name: Cheap Ground

tile_refund.description: Pays back every love you have spent on unlocking tiles so far.
tile_refund.name: Land Reclaim

wall_cost_discount.description: Blockers and Wall Builders cost {cost_reduction_pct}% less to build and to upgrade, never below 1 love. Picking it again discounts them further.
wall_cost_discount.name: Cheap Stonework
